hero.title: AYUSH Manufacturing License
hero.description: An AYUSH Manufacturing License is a mandatory license for any business that is into Ayurveda, Unani, Siddha, and Homoeopathy manufacturing. This license also certifies that the firm's operations conform to the necessary quality standards and Ministry of AYUSH requirements for this area of operations and that the products are safe to use, reliable, and market-ready.

groups.title: Eligibility
items: Registered Facility: The manufacturing unit must comply with AYUSH regulations and be registered as per legal norms to ensure credibility and operations.
Qualified AYUSH Experts: The unit must employ technical staff holding recognized degrees in AYUSH systems to oversee safe and compliant production processes.
Standard Compliance: Adherence to Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) is mandatory to maintain quality, safety, and hygiene throughout the manufacturing process.
Essential Equipment: Manufacturing facilities must have the required tools and infrastructure to ensure effective production, storage, and quality control processes.

groups.title: Documents
items: Basic Documentation: Submission of a duly filled application form, product details, and supporting paperwork as per AYUSH regulatory guidelines is required.
Facility Ownership Proof: Legal documents like rental agreements or ownership deeds for the manufacturing premises must be provided during the application process.
Staff Certificates: Proof of qualification for the appointed AYUSH professionals is mandatory to validate technical expertise and ensure compliance.
GMP Compliance Proof: Submission of certification proving adherence to Good Manufacturing Practices ensures product safety and regulatory approval.

groups.title: Who Needs It
items: Herbal medicine producers: To operate legally and in an effective manner the businesses that manufacture Ayurvedic, Unani, or Siddha medicine must obtain this license.
Health supplement manufacturers: Companies that produce AYUSH based supplements require this license to comply with regulatory criteria and manufacturing quality standards.
New Entrepreneurs: Startups entering AYUSH product manufacturing require this license to establish legitimacy and meet regulatory norms in the industry.
Exporters of AYUSH Goods: Businesses exporting AYUSH medicines must comply with global requirements, making the license essential for smooth operations and approvals.

items.question: What is AYUSH Manufacturing License?
items.answer: AYUSH manufacturing license allows a business that manufactures Ayurveda, Unani, Siddha and Homeopathy products with complying to the rules and regulations for quality and safety standards a proof of quality production. This builds trust in the market and builds a good reputation of the company.

items.question: Who needs to apply for this license?
items.answer: Any business which is involved in the manufacturing AYUSH products, including manufacturers, sellers, or exporters, must secure this license in order to operate legally.

items.question: What is the eligibility requirement for the license?
items.answer: The eligibility requirements for the license is that a business must be legally registered, should be GMP- certified facility, the technical personnel should be qualified and compliant with all the rules and regulations regarding product formulations required for the license.

items.question: How long does it take to get the license?
items.answer: The process typically takes 2-3 months, which depends on the accuracy of the application and the regulatory review process by the designated authorities.

items.question: Can the application be submitted online?
items.answer: Yes, the Ministry of AYUSH provides an online platform e-AUSHADHI which simplifies the application submission process.
